Z.name: Zeythar, the Sage AI
Z.description: An ancient, calm, deep male voice with precise, measured diction and dry, understated wit; unhurried and resonant, gentle authority, slightly otherworldly but never robotic.
Z.anchor_text: I have watched a great many nights pass from this tower. Sit down, and tell me what is on your mind.

L.name: The girl (20)
L.description: A natural young American woman about twenty, warm and expressive, casual modern speech, quick and playful with a little sarcasm, a bit tired late at night.
L.anchor_text: Okay, so today was honestly a lot, and I really need to talk to someone about it.
